stem.en: What happens to the ground-state energy of a particle in a box as the box is made narrower?
stem.et: Mis juhtub karbis oleva osakese põhioleku energiaga, kui karpi kitsamaks muuta?

label.en: It rises, because a shorter box forces a shorter wavelength and therefore a larger momentum
label.et: See tõuseb, sest lühem karp sunnib lühema lainepikkuse ja seega suurema impulsi

label.en: It falls towards zero, since the particle has less room in which to move
label.et: See langeb nulli poole, sest osakesel on vähem ruumi, kus liikuda

label.en: It reaches exactly zero once the box is small enough, leaving the particle at rest
label.et: See jõuab piisavalt väikese karbi korral täpselt nulli ja osake jääb paigale

label.en: It is unaffected, since energy levels are a property of the particle rather than the box
label.et: See ei muutu, sest energiatasemed on osakese, mitte karbi omadus
